newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bombs target banks, bar in Corsica.
newsitem.headline: Bombs target banks, bar in Corsica.

text.p: Bombs exploded outside two banks and a bar on the French Mediterranean island of Corsica early on Saturday, causing some damage but no injuries, police said.
The small blasts damaged a cash dispenser at a Credit Agricole branch and the gate of a Societe Generale branch in Moriani near Bastia.
A third blast damaged a bar in Ghisonaccia.
No one claimed responsibility for the bombings, which were apparently part of a long-standing campaign by separatist guerrillas.
